Miami-Dade County Florida Inmate Lookup — Official Guide

Finding inmate information in Miami-Dade County, Florida is easier when you know where to look and what resources are available. This guide provides official methods to search jail records and locate inmates housed in Miami-Dade County facilities.

How to Search Miami-Dade County Jail Records

  1. Visit the Miami-Dade County Department of Corrections and Rehabilitation website
  2. Navigate to the inmate search tool on their homepage
  3. Enter the inmate's last name or booking number
  4. Click the search button to retrieve available records
  5. Review the inmate's booking information, charges, and custody status
  6. Note the facility location and housing unit if available
  7. Contact the jail directly for additional information not displayed online

Official Miami-Dade County Resources

  • Miami-Dade County Department of Corrections and Rehabilitation
  • Florida Department of Law Enforcement Inmate Database
  • Miami-Dade County Public Defender's Office
  • Miami-Dade County Clerk of Courts Online Records
  • Bond Information and Payment Services

Bail Information for Miami-Dade County Florida

Bail amounts in Miami-Dade County are set according to Florida bail schedules and judicial review. Arrested individuals are typically brought before a judge within 24 hours for an initial appearance where bail is determined. You can post bail directly through the Miami-Dade County jail, use a licensed bail bondsman, or arrange payment through authorized third-party services. Bail amounts vary based on the severity of charges, prior criminal history, and whether the defendant poses a flight risk. Some inmates may be released on their own recognizance or given conditional release without posting bail.

Frequently Asked Questions

How long does it take for an arrest to appear in the Miami-Dade County inmate system?

Most arrests appear in the online database within 1-2 hours of booking. However, during high-volume periods or late-night hours, it may take up to 3-4 hours for information to be updated in the system.

Can I visit an inmate at Miami-Dade County jail?

Yes, Miami-Dade County facilities allow visits during designated hours. Visitors must pass a background check and follow facility rules. You can find specific visitation schedules and requirements on the Department of Corrections and Rehabilitation website.

What information do I need to look up an inmate in Miami-Dade County?

You can search using the inmate's full name or booking number. Having the booking date can help narrow results if the name is common. The inmate's case number or arrest agency may also be useful.
